title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

reports.title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

summary:
A former police officer from Costa Mesa pleaded guilty to contacting his mistress thousands of times through text messages, phone calls, and social media. On at least one day, he reached out to her more than 100 times. He also admitted to illegally accessing confidential law enforcement databases to track his wife, an ex-girlfriend, and several people he considered romantic rivals.

The guilty plea means he accepted responsibility for misusing police systems for personal surveillance and harassment. The article did not state what sentence he faces or when his next court appearance will be, so the next legal step is not clear from the information provided.
